name: 45402 · Dayton, OH
findings: ZIP 45402 (Dayton) has 276 nonprofit organizations. 134 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 116 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45402 (Dayton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
53% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
